title: Make compact next label shedding bounded and panic-free
outcome: The compact next fitter locates an eligible row before cloning, avoids non-test panics, and proves label shedding precedes row eviction.
acceptance: A fit-level boundary test proves label shedding alone preserves every ready row when it is sufficient to meet the response budget.
A large labeled compact-next fixture demonstrates predictable bounded fitting work without cloning the receipt for already-empty rows.
The label-shed path contains no undocumented panic or expect.

completion.summary: Made compact next label shedding bounded and panic-free: production selects and mutates one eligible row at a time without cloning the receipt, uses checked row access instead of expect, restores and continues after a non-reducing candidate, and sheds labels before evicting navigation rows.
